column1: # GT-PCAP labels for dnp3-resync-udp-report-cap and its twins (D6, brief P4-4-HR25, deliverable 3). The builder's, from how each capture was made (judge-labels); tshark's reading is reported beside them by resync_tshark.py, never used as a label.

# build: 201 flows m:40000+i, i = 0..200, each confirmed by P R before T0 and polled every 30 s to the end | flows 0..100: X:badchunk at T0 + 0.1 s x i | a fresh flow m:41000: X:badhdr x8 at T0 + 20 s | flows 101..200: X:badchunk at T0 + 60.5 s + 0.1 s x (i - 101) | capture ends at T0 + 125 s
# m is M5 192.0.2.14:20000 (link 5); o is O1 192.0.2.20:20000 (link 10). A capture is the case, or <case>--<twin> (section 3.3), or <case>--control.
# one row per link-layer unit, in the order sent (by unit, then flow, in a capture of many flows). label: valid, or the damage the unit's octets carry. fail: the case's failure the unit belongs to.
# packets: 1-based packet numbers, a-b for a run and a-b/s for every s-th; - for none. A gap row is a TCP hole left out of the capture: its packet is the peer's ACK past it (judge-r3).

# state: the builder's record of the message: seen when every frame is whole and valid (over UDP, each in one datagram), contiguous on its end apart from link-only frames and exact retries, and built to parse; lost when an octet is in a hole; absent otherwise, and why. The case's a cell is the expectation under C2A.
# a row whose unit is a..b, or whose flow is a..b, stands for that run of units or flows, each as the row says.
